title: Apple Pie Ice Cream
description: Apple peel-infused sweet cream ice cream with homemade eightfold boiled cider, warm pie spices, a bourbon apple compote swirl and buttery pie crumb.
cookTime: Varies; allow several hours if making boiled cider
totalTime: Overnight chilling plus churning and freezing
ingredients: 8 large apples, peels for infusion; reserve flesh for compote as needed
2 large whole eggs (use pasteurized eggs if making an uncooked base)
42 g homemade boiled cider (8× volumetric concentration)
Apple compote with bourbon, chilled (quantity TBD)
Butter crumb streusel, baked and cooled (quantity TBD)
steps: Make boiled cider if needed: simmer 3.785 L fresh unspiced apple cider uncovered in a wide pot until approximately 473 mL remains. Stir more frequently as it concentrates, reduce heat near the endpoint, and cool. Refrigerate excess syrup.

Wash the apples thoroughly, peel, and reserve the flesh for the compote. Gently warm the 2% milk and light cream with the peels from all eight apples. Cover and steep to extract apple aroma, then strain out the peels.

Whisk the two whole eggs with the 135 g sugar until light and well combined. Combine with the strained dairy. For an uncooked Ben & Jerry’s-style base, use pasteurized eggs and cool the dairy before mixing; if using ordinary eggs, gently heat the combined base with constant stirring to at least 71°C (160°F), then cool promptly.
Add 42 g cooled boiled cider gradually to the cooled base, along with a dash each of cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Whisk until smooth. Chill thoroughly overnight.

Prepare the apple compote using the Baked in Brooklyn apple pie filling recipe as the reference, including a little bourbon. Chill thoroughly. Prepare a buttery crumb streusel and cool completely. Exact inclusion amounts and formulations are pending the finished-product test.
Churn the chilled base according to the ice cream maker instructions. Layer or gently swirl in the chilled compote and crisp crumb during packing, then freeze until firm.
notes: IN DEVELOPMENT — Thanksgiving 2026, Batch 001. Base sensory test: tastes like apple pie filling; finished ice cream not yet evaluated. Modified Ben & Jerry’s easy home sweet cream base (whole eggs, not a yolk custard), with reduced sugar and light cream rather than heavy cream. Dairy weights are approximate equivalents based on the house vanilla recipe; actual weighed dairy quantities were not recorded in the discussion. The original heat treatment of the combined egg and dairy base was not specified; the method includes safe preparation options. Boiled cider was made from one gallon of fresh cider reduced to two cups and had an intensely apple-forward taste with a touch of acidity. Final compote and crumb quantities and procedures remain to be documented after churning.
